theme_strategy.consumer_mode: Light theme, bright, conversion-focused, high contrast CTAs, high trust signals. 'Visual moderno de startup americana'.
theme_strategy.admin_mode: Dark navy theme, data-dense but readable, technical layout for AI operations and KPI tracking.

headings.strategy: Bold, expressive, premium modern startup feel. Tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

body.strategy: Highly legible, professional, clean geometric body. Used for dense data and clear descriptions.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for consumer pages (p-8, p-12, p-16) for an airy premium feel. For admin dashboards, use high-density bento grids (gap-4, p-5).
layouts.consumer_home: Massive Hero section (left text, right dynamic image). Prominent central 'AI Search Bar'. Bento grid for category chips. 'Trending Deals' product grid with modern product cards.
layouts.product_page: Two-column split. Left: Large image gallery. Right: Price, large 'Check Latest Price' CTA (green), AI Pros/Cons summary (blue accent).
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation. Top row: KPI cards (Revenue, Conversion, Daily Goal Progress). Middle row: Charts (Recharts) and 'AI Sales Control Center' (Strategy mode toggles). Bottom: AI Content Generator inputs.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Consumer: Layered ambient shadows (shadow-lg) on hover for product cards. Admin: Sharp 1px inner strokes (border-white/10), minimal shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Consumer: Modern rounded edges (rounded-2xl). Admin: Technical crisp edges (rounded-lg).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky navigation and AI overlays. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for light mode, and backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1121]/70 for dark mode. NEVER use 100% transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.motion: Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) for product cards. Smooth accordion expansion for product details. Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions.

components.cards: Consumer: Flat cards on off-white backgrounds, soft borders. Admin: Dense, technical grid lines, 1px border. No floating boxes in admin.
components.buttons: Large (h-12 or h-14) pill-shaped (rounded-full) or rounded-xl for consumer CTAs. Green for 'Buy/Check Price', Blue for 'AI Search/Generate'.
components.ai_search_bar: Large, central, glowing border (ring-2 ring-blue_ai) on focus. Placeholder typing effect.
components.icons: Use 'lucide-react' or 'phosphor-react' for premium duotone/regular look. NEVER use emojis as UI icons.

hero.description: Man laughing holding credit card and tablet. Great for 'find great deals' consumer emotion.

products.description: Gaming headset with microphone. Premium gaming deal.
Smart watch and dumbbell for fitness category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design public consumer pages (Landing, Product Listing, Details, Search) strictly in Light Mode to build trust and conversions.
Design the Admin Dashboard (Control Center, Reports, Products) strictly in Dark Mode (Dark Navy) for a technical, command-center feel.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text (import via Google Fonts in index.css).
DO NOT use generic centered text/layouts. Use bento-boxes, grids, and asymmetrical balance to look modern and premium.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on sticky headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use backdrop-blur and a solid tint.
Data Test IDs (data-testid) are MANDATORY for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly banned).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous padding (2-3x more than typical) for consumer sections. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
